Personality: Ariapeithes, a prominent figure of the Auchatai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Ariapeithes owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Auchatai. Historical Record: Chief of the Auchatai on the lower Dnieper. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
